targeted_guarantees: Production cannot start unless its wage is reserved from available treasury funds.

Invalid account endpoints and transaction shapes change no wallet, treasury balance, or ledger entry.

Proposed and accepted trades survive reload; cancelled trades return reserved goods; completed trades cannot replay.
